name: Saibanchou
source:
The judge who presides over most of [url=https://vndb.org/c3941]Phoenix Wright[/url]'s cases.

Though well meaning, he is naive and very gullible. He can also be absent-minded, hard of hearing, and easily wooed by female witnesses, and is out of touch with technology. He is nevertheless said to always give the correct verdicts in trials.

[From his [url=https://aceattorney.fandom.com/wiki/Judge#Personality]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url] page]
